extraction_scope: Worker-2 bounded rework parsed the primary XML Table 1 antifungal IC50 matrix and cross-checked it against PDF text and linked DBAASP rows. Supplementary ZIP was checked and did not contain activity/toxicity tables.

identity_source_locator.primary_source_statement: Figure 2a and section 3.2 identify TaARL6IP4 as a 73-amino-acid TaArl6ip4 gene product with the HXXXG motif; no D-amino acid, amidation, cyclization, lipidation, or other modification is reported.

assay_conditions.method: growth inhibition measured spectrophotometrically at 595 nm in 96-well microtiter plates
assay_conditions.spore_suspension: 5 × 10^4 spores mL−1 in liquid NB medium
assay_conditions.assay_volume: 50 µL spore suspension plus 50 µL twofold serial diluted peptide
assay_conditions.replicates_statistics: Table 1 values are means ± standard deviations of three replicates; >200 µM rows are reported as above the highest tested concentration.

activity_records.review_notes: Recovered from XML Table 1 and checked against the PDF text and linked DBAASP assay rows; not database-only evidence.
